label: 11-04-26 School Committee Minutes

statements.statement: Superintendent presented a framework of FY28 budget priorities; the committee took no vote on an FY28 budget amount.

warnings.about: student opportunities, extracurriculars, athletics, social-emotional supports
warnings.prediction: Members expressed concern that another round of cuts would further limit student opportunities, and favored showing residents what would be lost under continued funding constraints.
Chair said current conditions for staff could not continue for another year.

warnings.about: student losses from funding not keeping pace
warnings.condition: if funding fails to keep pace with costs
warnings.prediction: Speakers urged the committee to show residents what students could lose over the next five years if funding fails to keep pace with costs.
